challenge.statement: How can our small neighbourhood bookshop get more people through the door on weekday afternoons?
challenge.context: Two of us run it, with one part-time helper. Weekends are busy, but between 1pm and 5pm on weekdays the shop is often empty. There's a primary school two streets away and a lot of people working from home nearby. We have a small back room we barely use and almost no marketing budget. We've tried a loyalty card and a few Instagram posts.

steps.note: Funny, costs nothing, and finally uses the back room.
Put the notice up on Tuesday. Two people asked about it by Thursday, and one came back on Friday with a laptop.
Dropped the first box with a regular on Monday.
She came back on Friday and bought one of the books, but wrapping and delivering took longer than we expected.
Could the winning shelves live in the back room?
Quoting people's posts back to them feels creepy.

own_idea.title: Story time for the school pickup crowd
own_idea.text: Read one picture book at 3:15 on Wednesdays, right after school pickup, so parents can browse while the kids listen.
